LightningComponentBundle.description: Layout-independent related list (GraphQL) for LSC/FSL child objects that Grace's classic Account layouts cannot hold. Patient 360 tabs; also the recruitment-journey (Opportunity) page.

property.name: childObject
property.label: Child object API name
property.description: e.g. HealthCondition, CareProgramEnrollee, Assessment, ServiceAppointment, CampaignMember

property.name: parentField
property.label: Lookup field on the child that points at the patient

property.name: parentIdSource
property.label: Match the lookup against (Account Id = this record's Id)

property.name: fields
property.label: Columns (comma-separated field API names; first is the link column; Rel.Field supported)
